comparison.objective: Select one requested M4×20 mm screw from size-coded bins and place it alone in a handoff tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Small-part identification, precision picking, and isolated placement.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly one correct M4 screw is released in the tray, wrong sizes remain in place, and nothing remains grasped; tier details beyond 0/0.25/0.5/1 are absent.
comparison.reason: Small-object picking and tray deposition are shared only as generic primitives; this record does not test bimanual impact, fracture, insert protection, or recovery of newly released fragments.
